mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plans (id, user_id, title, start_date, end_date, priority, success_criteria, estimated_minutes, carried_improvement, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{priority}, #{successCriteria}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{carriedImprovement}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE plans SET title = #{title}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, priority = #{priority}, success_criteria = #{successCriteria}, estimated_minutes = #{estimatedMinutes}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_revisions (id, plan_id, revision_no, title, start_date, end_date, priority, success_criteria, estimated_minutes, carried_improvement, revised_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{planId}, #{revisionNo}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{priority}, #{successCriteria}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{carriedImprovement}, #{revisedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.plan_id, r.revision_no, r.title, r.start_date, r.end_date, r.priority, r.success_criteria, r.estimated_minutes, r.carried_improvement, r.revised_at FROM plan_revisions r JOIN plans p ON p.id = r.plan_id WHERE r.plan_id = #{planId} AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.revision_no DESC, r.id ASC
